coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Use one coder sub-agent to own both `<workspace_root>/LLM_Reasoning_Survey.docx` and its dependent `<workspace_root>/LLM_Reasoning_Survey.pdf` exclusively. Create the Word document exactly once with the exact title and four main sections, include every frozen paper's authors, contribution, citation count, venue, and source-backed methodology comparison, and then read it back. Only after DOCX validation, call the authorized Word-to-PDF conversion once for the exact PDF filename. If that converter fails because LibreOffice/soffice/docx2pdf is unavailable, use `python_execute` once with the installed `python-docx` and `reportlab` packages to read the verified DOCX as the sole source and render the same headings, paragraphs, and tables into the exact PDF path; this is a true PDF generation fallback, not a renamed file or an independently rewritten survey. Then call the PDF information and page-reading tools, require a readable PDF larger than 5 KB with the title and all four section headings, and return both paths, heading/paper coverage, word/page controls, conversion route, and validation. Do not let any other agent write either file.
